## Social Media Carousel Automation
Each button in the Baserow **Content** table opens this workflow's webhook with `?action=…&row=…`. **Check Action** checks the row is ready, **Baserow: Set Status** shows the step is running, and **Route Action** sends the run to its lane below.

1 **▶ Brainstorm** → *research* → lane 1
2 **▶ Approve summary → fill plan** → *plan* → lane 2
3 **▶ Approve → create draft text** → *slides* → lane 3
4 **▶ Approve draft text → make style preview** / **↻ Redo style preview** → *images* → lane 4
5 **▶ Approve look → make the other slides** → *look* → lane 4
   **↻ Redo images** (slides ticked Redo) → *redo* → lane 4
6 **▶ Approve draft images** → *finalize* → lane 5

Every 15 minutes the schedule posts rows that are due on Instagram. If any step fails, the Error Trigger marks the row **Needs attention** with the reason at the top of the Posting log. All settings (tables, models, on/off switches) are in **Config**.

### Start · read the button, check the row, set the Status
Top: button clicks. Middle: the 15-minute Instagram schedule. Bottom: failed runs → row marked Needs attention.

### 1 · Brainstorm  (▶ Brainstorm)
Reuses saved research if a previous brief failed and nothing changed. Otherwise Claude plans 6–8 web searches (at least one per outline section), Tavily searches and reads your article links, the references are read (lane below), then Claude writes the Content Research Brief, Sources and a Suggested angle.

### 📚 Reading your references  (part of Brainstorm)
Articles → Tavily, page reader if Tavily fails · Instagram / TikTok posts → Scrape Creators · YouTube → Gemini watches (Scrape Creators transcript only if Gemini fails) · videos, images, carousels → Qwen, Gemini as backup · audio → Gemini · PDFs and text → DeepSeek. OpenRouter calls answer straight away; Magica runs (backup only) are started, then checked every 15 s until done.

### 2 · Post Creation Plan  (▶ Approve summary → fill plan)
Reads your Text style reference image (if any), then Claude fills the empty plan fields: Niche, Narrative prompt, Format prompt, Text style, Image style (one medium) and the defaults.

### 3 · Draft text  (▶ Approve → create draft text)
Claude writes each slide's Title, Body text and image prompt, plus the caption and hashtags, following your outline. This row's old slide rows are deleted and the new ones created. No images yet.

### 4 · Images  (style preview · other slides · redo)
**▶ Approve draft text** / **↻ Redo style preview** → draws only the style preview (first body slide). **▶ Approve look** → draws every other slide to match the preview. **↻ Redo images** → only slides ticked Redo (uses Redo note and Redo reference image). Images are text-free art from Nano Banana (OpenRouter). A vision check flags stray text or a text area that is too light, then the Editable slides .pptx is rebuilt with your Title and Body text on top.

### 5 · Save post  (▶ Approve draft images)
Google Drive folder with every slide, the .pptx and caption.txt (+ slideshow.mp4 from Creatomate if chosen) → private YouTube Short if chosen → Instagram now, or later by the schedule. TikTok is posted by hand from Drive.

### Instagram (API with Instagram Login)
Carousel: one container per JPEG + a parent; Reel: one container. Waits until Instagram has processed it, then publishes.
